items.title: CMS Energy (CMS) Stock Still Looks Cheap After Its 30% Run
items.summary: CMS Energy has seen its share price fall recently, even after a solid multi year run. That puts fresh focus on whether the current US$62.95 level lines up with the dividend stream on offer. For a utility that many investors watch primarily for income, the question is how well that payout really underpins the stock today.
